author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:

gist.headline: The mansion has questions
gist.blurb: Whodunnit joins the games list. Five AI suspects have alibis; one has a particularly interesting reason to rehearse theirs.
gist.summary: Adds guest453's Whodunnit to the games directory: a first-person 3D mansion mystery with five AI suspects and spoken questions transcribed by Pollinations.
gist.impact: Players can discover a browser mystery where they explore a mansion and question suspects out loud to test their alibis.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Whodunnit as a cozy pixel-art mansion mystery, with five suspect silhouettes, clue cards, and a microphone representing voice questioning. Polli wears a tiny detective hat and studies the clues beside a flower-lined path; keep the mystery curious rather than frightening.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art mansion foyer, five friendly suspect silhouettes stand near clue cards and a little microphone while Polli, wearing a tiny detective hat, studies their alibis beside potted pixel flowers. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, with consistent proportions and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow meets warm cream and lavender, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a gentle, nostalgic atmosphere.
